corporate.cwtSubtitle: (Independently owned and operated by Honeywell Travel Asg - Ltd)
corporate.cwtP1: Honeywell Travel is a leading travel agency in Cyprus, specializing in world-class business travel management. We are proud to be the official partner of CWT, a global leader in managing business travel and events across nearly 150 countries.
corporate.cwtP2: CWT focuses on four key pillars: Savings, Service, Security, and Sustainability. Through our partnership, we provide comprehensive travel management solutions that help businesses optimize their travel programs while ensuring the best possible experience for their employees.
corporate.cwtP3Suffix: to learn more about CWT's global capabilities and services.
corporate.cwtP4: Honeywell Travel is the international partner representative of CWT Global Partner Network in Cyprus.
corporate.destinationsSubtitle: From exotic paradises to business hubs, we manage corporate travel to destinations worldwide
corporate.whatWeDoP1: Honeywell Travel is a professional, well-established and licensed IATA Travel Agency, offering top-level travel consulting and services through its partnerships and a network of travel experts and professionals around the world.
corporate.whatWeDoP2: Since 1987, our company has been the official Partner of CWT, the biggest network of travel management companies worldwide. Our offices in Limassol and Nicosia are part of the A.S.G. (Andy Spyrou Group), providing comprehensive travel solutions to businesses across Cyprus.
corporate.whatWeDoP3: Our corporate clientele comprises multinational and local companies from all industries: the marine, pharmaceutical, banking, educational and telecommunications sectors, as well as public organizations.
corporate.whatWeDoP4: Our business travel management services go far beyond merely handling travel arrangements and taking care of transportation needs for our corporate clients. Our passionate, highly trained, dedicated team of travel consultants will ensure flawless conduction of all travel processes and requirements.
corporate.travelInsuranceP1: We know that you'd rather not think about all the things that may go wrong on your trip, but these things can and do happen. This is why here at Honeywell Travel we offer travel insurance, so that you can relax and enjoy your holiday knowing that we've got you covered!
corporate.travelInsuranceP2: We don't just keep you and your family protected, with us, you'll travel smarter and safer.
corporate.incentiveTripsP1: Incentive travel is business-related travel designed to reward employees, integrate new team members, and motivate existing ones. These trips are carefully crafted to provide unique experiences that strengthen community, foster new ideas, and promote teamwork.
corporate.incentiveTripsP2: From the magical reindeer sleigh rides in Lapland to sailing adventures in the Mediterranean, or stargazing under the desert sky, we offer diverse locations and atmospheres for any event. Each incentive trip is customized to meet your company's specific goals and budget.
corporate.incentiveTripsP3: These experiences not only reward your team but also increase employee loyalty and success. At Honeywell Travel, we offer suitable locations and atmospheres for any event, ensuring your incentive trip creates lasting memories and drives performance.
corporate.incentiveTripsAria: Incentive trips – professionals celebrating on a rooftop terrace overlooking the city
corporate.awardsP1: We are thrilled to announce that Honeywell Travel has been voted by the 27th World Travel Awards as Cyprus' Leading Travel Management Company for 2020.
corporate.awardsQuote: "This prestigious award came at an excellent time for us, inspiring us to never give up, regardless of the difficulties and the adversities." - Mary Spyrou, Executive Director of Honeywell Travel
corporate.awardsP2: World Travel Awards serves to acknowledge, reward, and celebrate excellence across all sectors of the global travel and tourism industry. On the 2nd November, the European winners were announced on a virtual ceremony.
corporate.awardsP3: Graham Cooke, Founder, World Travel Awards, says: "Our winners represent the very best of Europe's travel and tourism sector and my congratulations to each of them. They have all demonstrated remarkable resilience in a year of unprecedented challenges. The World Travel Awards 2020 programme received a record number of votes cast by the public. This shows that the appetite for travel and tourism has never been stronger and bodes well for the Industry's future as the global recovery begins."
corporate.awardsSignature: Honeywell Travel - A signature of Travel Management Excellence!

ourWorld.heroSubtitle: Discovering the world, one journey at a time
ourWorld.introP1: Here at Honeywell Travel, we are real people in a real workplace ready to offer you the best travel services.
ourWorld.introP2: We believe in authenticity, and we create experiences that excite you, challenge you and inspire you. We aspire to connect you with the world and make memories that will stay with you for life.
ourWorld.introP3: Our team of travel experts are people who share the same passion – a passion for traveling and discovering beautiful corners of the world. We are all traveling souls! We love exploring new destinations, living new experiences and sharing them with you all.
ourWorld.introP4: We strive to find the heart of every city and location, to find out what makes each place so special so that we can offer you the very best that every country has to offer.
ourWorld.introP5: With plenty of personal experience, the help of state of art technology, and with the advice of our trusted partners in various destinations, we provide you with the best travel recommendations tailored to your taste and preferences!
ourWorld.introP6: When it comes to business travel, we give our corporate clients a chance to concentrate on their own fields of expertise only, by offering them our own know-how on how to arrange sensible and cost efficient travel as well as comprehensive travel management.
ourWorld.introP7: We contribute to our client's traveler's success by putting everything they need at their fingertips and providing recommendations to help them navigate unfamiliar locations.
ourWorld.introP8: For meetings and events, it means delivering the perfect event so attendees have an enhanced experience and your company sees better return investment.
ourWorld.introP9: We believe that every trip should be as unique as you are, and therefore we have made it our main aim to provide you with an unforgettable, hassle-free, awe-inspiring and once-in-a-lifetime experience! And we always do this with a smile. 😊
ourWorld.awardsIntroP1: At Honeywell Travel, excellence is not a goal — it is our standard.
ourWorld.awardsIntroP2: We are proud to be recognized for delivering exceptional travel experiences, outstanding customer service, and tailor-made journeys worldwide.
ourWorld.awardsIntroP3: Our dedication to quality, reliability, and client satisfaction has earned us the trust of travelers, corporate clients, and institutions alike.
ourWorld.awardsIntroP4: Beyond leisure travel, we specialize in corporate travel management, business trips, conferences, and incentive programs, ensuring seamless planning, cost efficiency, and premium service for companies and organizations.
ourWorld.awardsIntroP5: Every award and recognition we receive reflects our passion for creating unforgettable journeys, successful business trips, and lifelong memories for our clients.
ourWorld.awardsIntroP6: When you travel with Honeywell Travel, you travel with confidence.

faq.wantVoucher: I WANT TO OFFER A GIFT VOUCHER
faq.q1: What can I do with my gift voucher?
faq.q1Intro: Contact us by phone, email, or visit our office directly and present your gift voucher (physical or e-gift format) to choose from all of Honeywell Travel's services:
faq.q2: How long can I keep my gift voucher?
faq.q2Answer: Your voucher is valid for 1 year from the date of purchase.
faq.q3: Can I use my gift voucher multiple times?
faq.q3Answer: Of course, you can use your voucher all at once or in multiple transactions if the amount of your gift voucher is higher than the service you have chosen. The remaining balance will then be available for a future booking.
faq.q4: Is my voucher refundable or exchangeable?
faq.q4Answer: Your gift voucher is neither refundable nor exchangeable.
faq.q5: How do I order my gift voucher?
faq.q5Answer: You can fill out the form below with the necessary information or contact us directly, and we will be happy to do it for you.
faq.q6: How and when will I receive my gift voucher?
faq.q6Answer: You will receive your voucher immediately via email after purchase if you have chosen the e-gift voucher version or a printable voucher. If you have chosen a physical voucher, it will be sent to you as soon as possible by postal mail, or you can pick it up at the office.
faq.q7: Can I choose the amount of the gift voucher?
faq.q7Answer: Of course, we do not impose any limit on the amount you wish to put on your gift voucher. The choice is yours.
faq.q8: I would like to offer a gift voucher for my company, is it possible?
faq.q8Answer: It is entirely possible to offer a gift voucher for a company committee. You can choose the quantity of gift vouchers you wish to offer in the questionnaire below.
faq.q9: What payment methods can I use to purchase my gift voucher?
faq.q9Answer: We accept all modes of payment, of course.
